title: C-3PO
subtitle: Rebel Alliance
description: C-3PO was a golden Protocol Droid that often introduced himself as an expert in etiquette, protocol, and human-cyborg relations, fluent in more than six millions forms of communications. Though he was programmed for such pursuits, his first job -that he remembered- was programming binary load lifters, making him an attractive purchase for Owen Lars, who wanted the Droid to work on his moisture farm.
